spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Owen speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I couldn’t pay my electricity bill on time because your mobile app was down. I’m really unhappy that your systems left me in this position.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that happened. I can look into the payment with you. Before we discuss any account details, could I take your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s verified. I can see the bill payment was due on 18 October. Is that the one you mean?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes. I tried several times and the app just kept failing. I had to pay late, and now I’m frustrated with Thistle Bank.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re upset, Femi, and I’m sorry the app wasn’t working when you needed it. I can put a note on your account about what happened.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: A note doesn’t really change the fact I was let down.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I hear you. I can explain the next step: you’ll receive a full written response within 8 weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So I just wait for that response?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. The next step is for you to receive that full written response within 8 weeks. I can’t say what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: To recap, I’ve noted that the app failure meant you paid your electricity bill late, and a full written response will be sent within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that’s clear. I’m still not happy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. Thank you for explaining what happened, Femi.
